intro.title: Investing in South Sudan's Future
intro.text: Five Investment Limited invests in key sectors that support economic development and improve the lives of communities throughout South Sudan. Our diversified investment strategy allows us to deliver sustainable solutions while creating long-term value for our partners and clients.

opportunities.title: Investment Opportunities
opportunities.text: Five Investment welcomes partnerships in infrastructure, agriculture, manufacturing, procurement, international trade, and public‑private partnerships.

items.question: What sectors does Five Investment operate in?
items.answer: We invest in construction, procurement, agriculture, import/export, light agro‑industries, and other areas such as mining, tourism, and renewable energy.

items.question: Can international organisations partner with Five Investment?
items.answer: Yes. We welcome partnerships with international NGOs, government agencies, and private investors.

items.question: Do you work with NGOs?
items.answer: Absolutely. We have a strong track record of supplying goods and services to humanitarian and development organisations.

items.question: Can you supply construction materials?
items.answer: Yes. We import and distribute a wide range of construction materials including cement, steel, and timber.

items.question: Do you undertake nationwide projects?
items.answer: We operate across all ten states of South Sudan and can scale to meet project needs anywhere in the country.

callToAction.title: Let's Build the Future Together
callToAction.text: Whether you're a government institution, NGO, investor, or private organisation, Five Investment Limited is ready to deliver reliable and sustainable investment solutions across South Sudan.
